stemMarkdown: The average weight of 9 students increases by 4 kg when a new student replaces one weighing 50 kg. What is the weight (in kg) of the new student?
solutionMarkdown: The total weight rises by $9 \times 4 = 36$ kg. That entire increase comes from one swap, so the new student is $36$ kg heavier than the one who left: $50 + 36 = 86$ kg.
